# Go packages tested by the CI on Windows (job "Go CLI (windows-latest)").
#
# Why a list: the first full run of the suite on Windows (run 39478681062)
# showed that 24 packages fail there, almost all because their tests were
# written for Unix (/tmp, fake binaries written as shell scripts, Unix
# sockets, file modes, "/" separators). To keep the CI green meanwhile, on
# Windows the Test step only runs the packages below, which pass. The 24 others
# are in windows-test-packages-excluded.txt, each with its main cause: making them
# green is the job of the "windows-tests" batch, which moves them from that file
# to this one. The other systems always run ./... .
#
# Format: one package per line, relative to the module (cli/), as printed by
# `go list ./...`; blank lines and # comments are ignored. The packages without
# test files are listed too: Windows then at least builds them.
# A package of `go list ./...` that is in neither file is not tested on Windows
# and is reported as a warning by the CI (.github/scripts/windows-packages.sh check).
.
